summary: The note describes a series of Wellness Workshops in the Local Health and Wellness community, run by life coach Emma Johnson and psychologist Dr. Robert Langley, that teach goal setting and resilience. Sessions began September 15, 2023 and run biweekly until December 12, 2023, mixing expert advice, role-playing, group discussion and peer coaching. Participant testimonials and a personalized toolkit with an alumni network illustrate the lasting benefits.
one_line: Biweekly Wellness Workshops led by Emma Johnson and Dr. Robert Langley teach SMART goal setting and resilience, with participant success stories and ongoing support tools.
key_facts: The Wellness Workshops on goal setting and resilience began on September 15, 2023.
The workshops occur biweekly until December 12, 2023.
Emma Johnson, a life coach, and psychologist Dr. Robert Langley organize the workshops.
Emma Johnson says, "Goals give us a roadmap," and believes clear, actionable goals are the cornerstone of growth.
Dr. Robert Langley has expertise in cognitive behavioral therapy and treats resilience as a trait that can be nurtured over time.
The workshops teach SMART goals: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Timebound.
Maria Gonzales, a participant, learned to set smaller, achievable goals and called the approach "incredibly empowering."
David Smith called the resilience training "a gamechanger," saying it removed fear of failure by teaching how to recover.
Resilience training uses real-life scenarios, roleplaying and group discussions, and covers mindfulness, self-care and building a positive support network.
Jasmine Turner launched her own small business after attending the workshops in late 2023.
Breakout sessions focus on peer-to-peer coaching and mentoring; John Carter valued talking openly about fears and offering support to others.
Each participant leaves with a personalized toolkit including resilience diaries, goal-tracking apps, recommended readings, and access to an alumni network.
